header.title: Test case generation workbench
header.description: Freeze a Skill target for “{{name}}”, generate cases with Claude and a pinned skill-creator, then review the validated draft before publishing an immutable revision.

tasks.title: Generation tasks
tasks.empty: No Evals have been generated. Use the generate button to configure a target and begin.

drawer.createDescription: Configure the frozen target and start generation. Closing the drawer does not cancel a running task.
drawer.detailDescription: Inspect the controlled Agent process, validated result, and human publication state.
drawer.activeTaskHint: A generation task is already running. Wait for it to finish, or open that task and cancel it.
drawer.reviewBeforePublish: Review the cases before publishing an immutable revision.
drawer.closeHint: Closing the drawer does not affect task execution.

progress.title: Building an Evals draft
progress.endedTitle: This generation did not produce a reviewable draft
progress.description: Target Skill: {{skillName}}. Output must pass path, schema, hash, and sensitive-data gates.
progress.agentThinking: The Agent completed an analysis message

review.title: Review Evals draft
review.emptyDescription: Generation never publishes automatically. Review every user task, expected result, objective assertion, and input file after validation.
review.resultPendingTitle: The generation result is not ready
review.resultPendingDescription: The complete cases will be available here after the Agent finishes and server validation succeeds.
review.noInputFiles: This case has no input files

controls.title: Generation settings
controls.briefPlaceholder: For example: prioritize scanned documents, missing fields, and multi-currency boundaries.
controls.freezeHint: Starting freezes the selected target and copies the Skill, skill-creator, and Claude settings into an isolated workspace. Source files are never written back.

publish.title: Publication gate
publish.noDraft: Select a successfully validated task to review its draft summary and publication actions.
publish.confirm: Published Evals revisions cannot be changed. Confirm that every case has been reviewed and publish?
publish.discardConfirm: A discarded draft cannot be published, but its task record remains. Discard it?

revisions.title: Published revisions
revisions.empty: No Evals revisions have been published.

states.loadErrorDescription: Make sure the local service and database are running, then retry.

footer.snapshotBoundary: Target Skill and generation dependencies use controlled copies
footer.publishBoundary: Only a human-confirmed draft becomes an immutable revision
